title: Publish marketplace onboarding docs pages + fix nav/SEO/redirects for AWS & GCP listings
creator: Alex Martinez
description:
## Context
We’re refreshing AWS + GCP Marketplace listings and need a clean, buyer-friendly docs path from the listing CTA through subscription → entitlement → Redwood org provisioning → first API key → first successful request.

Marketplace partner review also requires stable, public URLs for onboarding and a security overview. Docs pages must be easy to find, indexable, and correctly linked from listings, console UI, and security packet.

This ticket covers the **docs site engineering** work (IA, nav, SEO, internal links, redirects), not the copy itself.

## Goals
1) Publish marketplace onboarding pages for AWS and GCP with a consistent IA.
2) Ensure pages are discoverable (nav + search), and **URLs are stable** for marketplace submission forms.
3) Fix internal linking across onboarding docs, troubleshooting, pricing/packaging, and the security packet.
4) Add redirects from any legacy/old marketplace doc URLs used in prior listings, sales decks, or customer emails.

## In scope
- Add / validate docs IA for marketplace onboarding
  - Landing page: overview + “choose your marketplace” split
  - AWS guide: subscribe → entitlement → link org → create API key → first call
  - GCP guide: same flow with GCP-specific billing/entitlement language
  - Troubleshooting page for common failure modes (entitlement propagation delay, org already exists, multiple subscriptions, wrong email/identity, region mismatch)
  - FAQ entry points (procurement, billing, support)
- Navigation + SEO
  - Add to left nav under “Getting started” (or “Onboarding”) with clear label “Marketplace (AWS/GCP)”
  - Ensure correct titles/meta descriptions; avoid duplicate titles
  - Canonicals set correctly (no duplicated content between AWS/GCP pages)
  - Add “noindex” only for content explicitly marked internal (should not apply here)
- Redirects + link hygiene
  - Implement redirects for legacy URLs (tracked via INT-771)
  - Fix/avoid broken anchors after nav re-org
  - Ensure security packet links resolve to final public URLs

## Out of scope
- New product functionality in console onboarding (tracked in ENG-22112)
- Entitlement verification API behavior (ENG-22110)
- Security evidence hosting / gating rules (handled in Security docs publication plan; this ticket only ensures links point correctly)

## Proposed URL structure (final)
- /docs/marketplace
- /docs/marketplace/aws
- /docs/marketplace/gcp
- /docs/marketplace/troubleshooting
- /docs/marketplace/faq

(Exact path can vary, but must be stable and confirmed for marketplace submissions.)

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Marketplace onboarding pages are live in docs site with stable URLs.
- [x] Pages are included in left nav and show up in docs search.
- [x] All internal links validate (CI link checker or equivalent) with zero broken links.
- [x] Redirects exist for known legacy marketplace doc URLs (see INT-771) and are verified in preview.
- [x] Pages reference the correct next steps:
  - “Link subscription to an existing Redwood org” flow
  - “Create API key” location in console
  - “First request” example (SDK + curl)
- [x] Troubleshooting includes guidance for entitlement propagation delays (expected ranges + retry guidance) and when to contact support.

## Implementation notes
- Keep AWS and GCP content separate where procurement/billing steps differ; avoid copy/paste duplicates that confuse canonicalization.
- Add a lightweight callout on each marketplace page linking to:
  - Security overview for marketplace buyers
  - Pricing/packaging page for marketplace SKUs (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
  - Support + escalation routing for marketplace onboarding
- Coordinate with DevEx for the “first call” code snippet source of truth to avoid drift from SDK docs.

## Testing checklist
- Validate in preview build:
  - Nav ordering and breadcrumbs
  - Search indexing settings (site config)
  - Redirect behavior for 5–10 known old URLs
  - Link checker passes
  - Mobile layout for step-by-step sections

## Launch / comms
- Confirm final URLs with Partnerships + PMM before marketplace submission (AWS/GCP portals require exact links).
- After merge, notify:
  - Chris Osei (program lead)
  - Soojin Lee (PMM)
  - Stephanie Nguyen / Lukas Meyer (Sales stakeholders)
  - Naomi Feldman (Security/compliance product owner) for cross-link validation
